description: This file defines the OrganizationWatchlistOperationsService class, which extends WatchlistOperationsService to manage watchlist entries related to organizations, including permission checks, adding entries by email/domain, and dismissing reports.

classes.name: OrganizationWatchlistOperationsService
classes.description: A service class for managing organization-specific watchlist entries with permission checks and report linking.

methods.name: getScope
methods.description: Returns the scope of the watchlist operation, scoped to the organization.

methods.name: checkPermission
methods.description: Checks if a user has the specified permission within the organization.

methods.name: createWatchlistEntry
methods.description: Creates a new watchlist entry after permission validation.

methods.name: deleteWatchlistEntry
methods.description: Deletes a watchlist entry after permission validation.

methods.name: addToWatchlistByEmail
methods.description: Adds an email or domain to the watchlist, linking pending reports and returning the result.

methods.name: dismissReportByEmail
methods.description: Dismisses reports associated with an email.
